meta.title: XMind to Excel
meta.description: Converts .xmind mind maps into .xlsx workbooks with two tools. xmind_to_excel writes one of four views — outline (one row per node with level columns), testcase (cases whose titles start with the verbs 验证/校验/测试), checklist (cases chosen by tree level, expectations taken from child nodes), matrix (leaf paths with merged ancestor cells) — or all of them at once. xmind_inspect first summarizes canvases, node counts, the depth distribution and sample titles, so the view and the case levels fit the map. The workbook is written next to the input file unless an output path is given; input is limited to 50 MB. Everything runs locally: no network requests and no uploads. Only text structure is converted — images, stickers, relationship lines, summaries and layout positions are dropped, and floating topics appear as ordinary children. Case extraction is rule-based, so review the first rows when the titles are not written in a recognizable style. Turning the bundle off removes both tools and the bundled skill.
